findings.title: Pharmacy owner cannot view or respond to organization claim requests because the review section is hidden when no pharmacies are already claimed
findings.scenario: Lina submits a claim request for Tom's independent pharmacy so her organisation can manage it. When Tom logs into the web dashboard to review his pharmacies, the claim requests section is hidden because Tom does not yet have any claimed or linked pharmacies. Tom cannot view Lina's request, read her message, or approve the claim, leaving the request permanently pending.
findings.test_needed: Render the owner pharmacies page with an unclaimed pharmacy and a pending claim request, asserting the claim requests accordion and approve button are visible.

owner_question.question: When Lina submits a claim request to manage Tom's independent pharmacy, how should Tom see and act on the request in his dashboard?
options: Outcome A: Show the claim requests section whenever Tom has pending or past claim requests, regardless of whether any pharmacy is already claimed.
Outcome B: Direct Tom from email and alerts to a dedicated claim requests page rather than embedding it inside the pharmacies list.
Outcome C (keep today's behaviour): Hide the claim requests section until Tom already has at least one claimed or organization-linked pharmacy.
